environment: Mac Apple Silicon, ROS 2 Lyrical, Gazebo Jetty 10.4

depth_interpolation.scope: OceanCurrentModelPlugin topic publication and linear interpolation at two fixed depths. Static probes isolate interpolation from vehicle dynamics.

vehicle_physical_response.tested_path: OceanCurrentWorldPlugin and ROS wrapper -> stratified database -> OceanCurrentModelPlugin -> /model/rexrov/ocean_current -> Gazebo Hydrodynamics -> REXROV motion
limitations: Vehicle state at the beginning of each recorded window was not identical.
This establishes functional application, not hydrodynamic-coefficient accuracy.
This does not establish real-ocean or general physical accuracy.

established: OceanCurrentModelPlugin publishes vehicle-specific ROS and Gazebo topics.
The stock database is interpolated correctly at fixed depths of 5 m and 15 m.
The vehicle-specific current is consumed by Gazebo Hydrodynamics.
A +1.5 m/s X current changes actual REXROV motion relative to zero current.
not_established: Repeatability beyond one physical run per condition.
Tidal evolution, non-zero noise, multi-vehicle isolation or long stability.
